display_name: The Virgins and Priests of Ascalon and Gaza

names.form: Των εν Ασκάλωνι και Γάζη παρθένων γυναικών και ιερωμένων ανδρών
names.note: Read out of saint.gr's own heading for the entry on the life page for 29 Μαρτίου, «Των Εν Ασκαλωνι Και Γαζη Παρθενων Γυναικων Και Ιερωμενων Ανδρων».

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding menologion day (30 September 2026).
Not checked: doxologia.ro's calendar for the same civil day (30 September 2026).

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 29ης Μαρτίου — «Άγιος Μάρκος επίσκοπος Αρεθουσίων, Κύριλλος διάκονος, και των εν Ασκάλωνι και Γάζη παρθένων γυναικών και ιερωμένων ανδρών»

attestations.note: They stand as an entry of their own in the page's list of those commemorated, with a couplet of their own, and the page names not one of them and counts none of them: «αρκετές παρθένες γυναίκες στην Ασκάλωνα και τη Γάζα, καθώς και μερικοί ιερωμένοι» — a number of virgin women at Ascalon and at Gaza, and some men in holy orders. One folder, because the source enumerates nobody. Both the apolytikia it prints name Mark and Cyril and then these women and priests, so the first of them is copied here as well as onto their folders.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 11.04.2026 (29. март ст. ст.) — „Свети Марко Исповедник, епископ Аретусијски у Сирији“ … „Истога дана кад и свети Кирил пострадаше и многи други. Злобни незнабошци исекоше тела њихова на комадиће, помешаше с јечмом, и дадоше свињама.“

attestations.note: The closing sentences of the day's first entry, and the identification is a reading of the account and not of a name, because the Prologue names nobody here and gives neither Ascalon nor Gaza, neither the virginity of the women nor the orders of the men: it says only that on the same day as Cyril many others suffered, and that their bodies were cut to pieces, mixed with barley and given to the swine. What joins it to this folder is that the entry opens by naming its own authorities, свети Григорије Богослов and блажени Теодорит, and that the barley and the swine are the distinctive mark of the Theodoret passage which doxologia.ro quotes in full for exactly this company and which this folder's own life carries from saint.gr — the same passage, in the same place, immediately after the same deacon's death, on the same menologion day the Greek already keeps here. On that ground the row goes on this folder and no new one was made; a company the source enumerates nowhere is one folder in any case. **No Serbian name form** is stored, because the page prints no designation for them at all, and a form that is not on the page is left out rather than supplied. The entry gives them no year, so the death this folder already holds from saint.gr is untouched. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion.

death.note: saint.gr sets the whole company under Julian the Apostate, «Επί Ιουλιανού του Παραβάτη (363 μ.Χ.)», in the same sentence in which it says they died the same death as the deacon Cyril. It gives them no year of their own.

hymns.tone: Ἦχος δ’. Ὁ ὑψωθεῖς ἐν τῷ Σταυρῷ.
hymns.text: Ἀρεθουσίων ὁ σοφὸς Ποιμενάρχης, ὑπὲρ Χριστοῦ Μᾶρκε στερρῶς ἠνωνίσω, ἐν τὴ Φοινίκη δὲ ὢ Κύριλλε Διάκονε, Μάρτυς ὤφθης ἔνθεος, καὶ ἐν Γάζῃ τὴ πόλει, ἅμα καὶ Ἀσκάλωνι, Ἱερεῖς θεοφόροι, μετὰ Γυναίων ἤθλησον σεμνῶν, οὖς ὡς ὀπλίτας, Χριστοῦ μακαρίσωμεν.

source.text: saint.gr — Άγιος Μάρκος επίσκοπος Αρεθουσίων, Κύριλλος διάκονος, και των εν Ασκάλωνι και Γάζη, Ἀπολυτίκιον. It is the one hymn for the whole company and names Mark, Cyril, the God-bearing priests and the modest women in turn. Recorded with kind troparion, which is the schema's word for it.

english.text: Mark, wise chief shepherd of Arethusa, you contended stoutly for Christ; and in Phoenicia you, O Cyril the deacon, were shown a martyr filled with God; and in the city of Gaza, and at Ascalon with it, God-bearing priests together with modest women contended — whom let us call blessed as the armed men of Christ.
